build_quantized_bert_model: build a quantized BERT model using BertModel with configurable weight and input bit widths
create_bert_sequence_classifier: create a BERT sequence classification model using BertForSequenceClassification with a custom number of labels
create_bert_qa_model: create a BERT question answering model using BertForQuestionAnswering to predict start and end span positions
load_pretrained_quantized_bert: load a pretrained quantized BERT model from a directory using BertPreTrainedModel.from_pretrained
review_bert_quantization_config: review the BertConfig to understand quantization settings like weight_bits, input_bits, and quantization methods
